name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
